reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 以圖示指出目前調諧的電台是否在一天中的某些時段播送交通報導（TP 旗標）。關鍵情境條件：電台是否帶 TP 旗標——兩個值類都必須觀察，只驗有 TP 的一側無法排除「永遠顯示圖示」的實作（§7）。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 內以帶 TP 與不帶 TP 的兩個電台涵蓋旗標的兩個等價類，依 §5.7 屬同一驗證目標（圖示如實反映旗標），不拆分。刻意略過：TA 旗標與播報中圖示由 055 覆蓋；圖示的外觀規格屬同節未配置條款 4872537（依歐洲 RDS 規範與 HMI 文件），該條款位於 §1.3.13.1 而本 leaf 條款在 §1.3.13，跨節不符 R10-2 吸收條件，記為覆蓋缺口送 RD-1。

tcs.tc_title: Traffic Program icon reflects whether the station carries traffic announcements
tcs.test_item: Traffic Program Flag (TP): HU shall display icon indicating whether the currently tuned station broadcasts traffic announcements at some time in the day
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The vehicle is configured for a market where the RDS feature set applies, such as EMEA - Europe
3. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
4. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
tcs.input_test_data:
Station T broadcasting RDS data with the TP flag set
Station U broadcasting RDS data with the TP flag not set
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Tune the HU to station T
2. Read the icon area of the FM Radio Playing page
3. Tune the HU to station U
4. Read the icon area of the FM Radio Playing page
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is tuned to station T
2. The traffic program icon is displayed
3. The HU is tuned to station U
4. The traffic program icon is not displayed
